scope: Explicitly reviewed multiple catalogue editions of one physical source. Similar bodies or repeated transmissions with different source locations are not merged.

records.finding: The complete literal ciphertext, source location, header and published key agree. p132_B is a later source/model edition of challenge p132, not another reception or physical source.
records.counting_rule: Keep both catalogue entries and their original IDs and credits visible. Count their shared source once in physical-source totals; p132_B adds one reviewed edition entry and zero physical sources beyond the challenge set.

limits: This register contains one exact same-source overlap. It does not merge records merely because their ciphertext or plaintext resembles another transmission.

Every duplicate printed-page/source-section location must be registered and supported by identical literal source bytes. An unregistered alias, including a p153_C5 entry for challenge p153a, is rejected.
The frozen catalogue rows and source proposals remain unchanged. The register supplies a separately verified identity relation and display annotation.
